notes.general_comments:
As this paper was taken by only 47 candidates, a statistical analysis of candidates’ performance, particularly
in relation to individual questions, would not be particularly meaningful. However, for the record, the overall
mean percentage score was 42.2%%. This is considerably below the score achieved by candidates on the
corresponding paper in 2012, but given the small number of candidates, any such comparison is not
statistically significant.
There were three Questions, 7, 17, and 19 which candidates found particularly difficult.
